title: Paydown Reduction for Plan Installments: Deficiency Balance Accounts Training Note
content:
**Rule.** The installment of a new payment plan on an account held under Deficiency Balance Accounts is reduced for what the account has already paid down. The plan paydown share is the total amount of the account's posted payments and applied credits, less the total amount of its returned payments, divided by the original deficiency. A plan paydown share of 0.4 (40 percent) or more reduces the installment by 6.0 percent, one of at least 0.2 (20 percent) but below 0.4 by 3.0 percent, and a smaller one by nothing.

## Ladder

| Plan paydown share | Reduction |
|---|---|
| 0.4 or more | 6.0 percent |
| 0.2 up to but not including 0.4 | 3.0 percent |
| Below 0.2 | None |

## Questions answered

**Which postings enter the share?** Every payment posted on the account and every credit applied to it, from opening to today, less every returned payment. The forgiven remainder of a settlement is not a payment or a credit.

**What is the share divided by?** The original deficiency on the opening date, never the current balance.

## Worked shares (hypothetical; original deficiency $5,000.00)

| Payments posted | Credits applied | Returned | Paid down | Share | Reduction |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $1,800.00 | $300.00 | $100.00 | $2,000.00 | 0.40 | 6.0 percent |
| $1,800.00 | $300.00 | $150.00 | $1,950.00 | 0.39 | 3.0 percent |
| $1,000.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $1,000.00 | 0.20 | 3.0 percent |
| $990.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $990.00 | 0.198 | None |
